# Upper Crust Pizza

> Family-owned pizzeria in Whitefish Bay, Wisconsin since 1987. Hand-tossed Wisconsin-style pizza with online ordering, pickup, and local delivery to the Milwaukee North Shore and surrounding neighborhoods.

## Business

- **Name:** Upper Crust Pizza
- **Type:** Local pizza restaurant (dine-in neighborhood spot, pickup, delivery)
- **Address:** 249 East Hampton Avenue, Whitefish Bay, WI 53217, United States
- **Phone:** (414) 332-6820
- **Website:** https://uppercrustpizza.netlify.app/
- **Online ordering:** https://uppercrust.hungerrush.com/Order/

## Service area (delivery & pickup)

Upper Crust Pizza primarily serves customers in and near Whitefish Bay, including:

- Whitefish Bay, WI
- Shorewood, WI
- Fox Point, WI
- Bayside, WI
- Glendale, WI
- River Hills, WI
- Milwaukee North Shore / East Side areas

Delivery availability may vary by address; customers should confirm at checkout when ordering online.

Place orders online at https://uppercrust.hungerrush.com/Order/ for the fastest pickup or delivery experience.

## Contact

For questions about hours, catering, or your order, call **(414) 332-6820** or visit the restaurant at the address above during business hours.
